scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names client,server --prefix-colors cyan,yellow "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.build: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names client,server --prefix-colors cyan,yellow "npm run build:client" "npm run build:server"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix client && npm run lint --prefix server
scripts.check:release: npm run lint && npm run build
